Two consecutive ECMWF IFS 0.25° mean-sea-level pressure frames, cropped
to southern Australia. ECMWF open data, CC BY 4.0
(https://www.ecmwf.int/en/forecasts/datasets/open-data).
Little-endian float16, north-to-south, west-to-east. See header.json.
Rebuild with tools/extract-fieldrender-fixture.py --store ROOT --out DIR.
The store is read only.
